The editable SFF 2026 application packet is canonical in Notion, not in the manual repo.

- [SFF 2026 Canonical Budget Source](https://app.notion.com/p/39863f8d1d3b8182a8fdf8d395fe5dc0)

- [SFF Share-Transfer Budget Model](https://app.notion.com/p/39863f8d1d3b81aa9c07cda243f09082)

Generated/local artifacts:

- `E:/eos/tmp/sff-artifacts/` contains disposable generated print sources.
- `E:/eos/ic2ewd/fundraising/sff-2026/` contains filing/submission PDFs.

Do not edit this file as an application draft. Update Notion first, then regenerate artifacts.
